151: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Gauri Guareri · Chaupade Dupade · Guru Nanak
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
The fear of God is very heavy, and its weight is great.
The mind-led intellect is shallow, and speaks only shallow words.
Placing His fear upon one's head and bearing its weight,
by His glance of grace, one is blessed with the Guru's reflection. ॥1॥
ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Without the fear of God, no one crosses over.
ਭੈ ਭਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who keep the fear of God within, adorned with His love, (cross over). ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ; ਭੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Through the fear of God, the fire (of longing for Him) blazes in the body.
Through the fear of God, adorned by the Word, the mind is shaped in His fear.
Without the fear of God, what is shaped is utterly shallow and false.
Blind is the mould, and blind the hammer-blow. ॥2॥
The intellect is caught up in the play of the world, and craving for it wells up.
Even with a thousand clever tricks, the true shaping does not come.
O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed is empty wind;
his words are blind, worthless and vain. ॥3॥1॥
ਡਰਿ ਘਰੁ. ਘਰਿ ਡਰੁ; ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
In Your fear one reaches Your home; in Your home one dwells in Your fear; through Your fear, all fear departs.
ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਡਰਿ. ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
What kind of fear is that, which brings fear with it?
Without You there is no other place of rest.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Whatever happens is all by Your will. ॥1॥
One lives in dread when there is fear of anything other than You.
ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ; ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Being afraid and ever afraid is only the turmoil of the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
The soul does not die; it does not drown, nor does it swim across.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
He who created everything does everything.
By His command we come, and by His command we go.
Here and hereafter, we are absorbed in His command. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ; ਨੈ ਸਾਨੁ ॥
within such a heart is great hunger, surging like a river.
The fear of God is the food, drink and support of the soul.
Without eating it, the fools die (in fear). ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਈ; ਕੋਇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Rare is the one who truly has someone of his own;
ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
everyone is Yours, and You are the Lord of all.
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ; ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.
O Nanak, it is very difficult to describe and reflect on Him. ॥4॥2॥
Let wisdom be the mother, and contentment the father;
let truth (service) be the brother — this is the best. ॥1॥
ਕਹਣਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Something may be said, but He cannot be described.
ਤਉ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The value of Your creation cannot be estimated. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
152: Let modesty (effort) and higher awareness be the two in-laws,
and make good deeds your spouse, O mind. ॥2॥
Let joining the holy company be the wedding date, and detachment from the world the marriage;
then Truth is the offspring; says Nanak, this is true union. ॥3॥3॥
From the union of air, water and fire (the body is formed),
and in it plays the restless, fickle intellect.
There are nine doors, and then the Tenth Gate.
Understand this reflection, O wise one. ॥1॥
He alone is the one who speaks, teaches and listens.
ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ; ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One who reflects on his own self becomes spiritually wise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The body is clay; the breath speaks within it.
ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਮੂਆ ਹੈ. ਕਉਣੁ ॥
Understand, O wise one: who is it that has died?
The pull of Maya, strife and ego have died;
but the One who watches over all has not died. ॥2॥
That for which you go to the shores of the places of pilgrimage —
that priceless jewel is within the heart itself.
The pandit reads and reads, and stirs up arguments,
but does not know the treasure within. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
I have not died; the demon (of attachment) within me has died.
ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ; ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
He who is all-pervading has not died.
Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,
and now I see that He is not subject to birth and death. ॥4॥4॥
One who listens and listens, understands, and accepts the Name —
to him I am forever a sacrifice.
When the Lord Himself leads one astray, one finds no place of rest.
When You give understanding, You unite one in union with Yourself. ॥1॥
May I be blessed with the Name, which will go along with me.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਬਾਧੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, all are bound by death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Let the Name be the support of your farming and your trade.
Sin and virtue are the bundle of seed (for the next life).
Those whose hearts are struck by lust and anger
forget the Name and depart with evil in their minds. ॥2॥
Those who receive the true teaching of the True Guru
are cooled in body and mind; they recognise the True One.
Like the water-lily and the lotus that cannot live without water,
they are imbued with the Word, sweet like the juice of sugarcane. ॥3॥
By His command and through past destiny, in the fortress of the body with its ten gates,
the holy ones dwell, merged in the infinite Light.
He Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.
O Nanak, through the Name He adorns their lives. ॥4॥5॥
How can we know where (desire) comes from,
where it arises and where it goes and merges?
How is one bound, and how does one find liberation?
How does one merge in the poise of the Imperishable Lord? ॥1॥
One who has the Ambrosial Name in the heart, and the Name on the lips,
through the Name of the Lord becomes desireless like the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By natural law it comes, and by natural law it goes.
ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
From the mind it arises, and in the mind it is absorbed.
The Guru-facing one is liberated, and is not bound.
Reflecting on the Word, he is released through the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
Many birds settle on the tree for the night;
some are happy and some sad; with attachment in their minds they are ruined.
At dusk they arrive, and at dawn they look to the sky,
and fly off in all ten directions, according to their written destiny. ॥3॥
153: Those attuned to the Name regard the world as a temporary camp in a pasture.
Their pot of the poison of lust and anger bursts.
Without the merchandise (of the Name), the house and shop of the heart are empty.
Meeting the Guru, the heavy doors are opened. ॥4॥
Through destiny from the past, one meets the Holy Guru;
the perfect people of the Lord delight in the True One.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇ; ਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Giving body and mind, they receive (the Name) with ease and love.
O Nanak, I fall at their feet. ॥5॥6॥
Lust and anger are in me; my mind is engrossed in Maya.
My love and consciousness are awake to falsehood and vice.
I have gathered the capital of sin and greed.
Let Your purifying Name be in my mind as the raft to carry me across. ॥1॥
ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ; ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Wonderful, wonderful are You, O True Lord; You are my only support.
ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ; ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am a sinner; You alone are pure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Fire and water (heat and coolness) prevail by turns, and so one speaks hot and cold words.
The tongue and each sense have their own taste.
The eyes are fixed on vice; there is neither fear nor love (of God).
Only by killing self-conceit is the Name obtained. ॥2॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who dies through the Word does not die again.
Without dying (to self), how can one become perfect?
The mind remains engrossed in deceit and duality.
Whatever the steady Lord does, that alone comes to pass. ॥3॥
I can board the ship only when my turn comes.
Those kept from boarding the ship are punished at His court.
Blessed is the Guru's door, where I praise the True One.
O Nanak, at that door, in the home of the heart, is the One Lord. ॥4॥7॥
Reflecting on God, the lotus of the heart is turned (away from Maya).
The stream of nectar flows into the sky of the Tenth Gate.
The Lord Himself pervades the three worlds. ॥1॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
O my mind, do not wander in doubt.
ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When the mind accepts (His praise), it drinks the ambrosial essence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Winning life's purpose, the mind accepts death (of self).
ਆਪਿ ਮੂਆ; ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
When self-conceit dies, the mind knows it from within itself.
ਨਜਰਿ ਭਈ; ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
When His glance of grace comes, one recognises His home within one's own home. ॥2॥
Celibacy, truth, pilgrimage and bathing are all in the Name.
What use is it to make a great display?
The Lord knows the hearts of all. ॥3॥
ਆਨ ਮਨਉ; ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ ॥
Only if I believed in another would I go to another's house.
Whom should I beg from? There is no other place.
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching I merge in poise. ॥4॥8॥
When the True Guru is met, he shows one the way of dying (to vice).
The joy of this death and of the life that follows becomes pleasing within.
Shedding pride, one attains the city of the higher sky (of the spirit). ॥1॥
All come with death written in their destiny; no one stays here.
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਿ; ਰਹਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chanting and meditating on the Lord, one dwells forever in the Lord's sanctuary. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the True Guru is met, duality runs away.
ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ; ਮਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
The lotus of the heart blossoms, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.
One who dies while yet alive enjoys the supreme delight here and hereafter. ॥2॥
Meeting the True Guru, one becomes pure through truth and self-discipline.
Climbing the Guru's ladder, one rises higher and higher.
ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੩॥
By His grace (the Guru) is met, and the fear of death is gone. ॥3॥
Meeting the Guru, one merges in His embrace.
In His mercy, he shows one the mansion of the Lord's presence.
O Nanak, subduing ego, he unites one with the Lord. ॥4॥9॥
154: No one can erase the record of past deeds.
What do I know of what will happen hereafter?
Whatever pleases Him, that alone has come to pass.
There is no other doer besides Him. ॥1॥
ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ; ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
I do not know (the worth of) my deeds, nor how great Your gifts are.
ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ; ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your Name is my deeds, my faith and my caste. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are such a great Giver, the One who gives.
Your treasures of devotion never run short.
Pride in oneself never works out;
soul and body are all in Your hands. ॥2॥
You kill (my self-conceit) and revive me; forgiving me, You unite me with Yourself.
As it pleases You, You inspire me to chant the Name.
ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
You are all-knowing and all-seeing; You, the True One, are over my head.
You give me the Guru's teaching; I rely on You alone. ॥3॥
ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
There is no filth in the body of one whose mind is dyed in Your love.
Through the Guru's words and the Word, he has recognised the True One.
Your power is his strength; he proclaims the glory of Your Name.
O Nanak, Your devotees abide in Your sanctuary. ॥4॥10॥
One who has spoken of the Indescribable and inspired others to speak of Him has drunk the Nectar and given it to others to drink.
His other fears are forgotten, and he is absorbed in the Name. ॥1॥
Why should one be afraid? Fear is dissolved in the fear of God,
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for one who has recognised Him through the Word of the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ; ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
The person whose heart holds the Lord as his wealth
dwells in poise and love, and is applauded (at His door). ॥2॥
Those whom He keeps asleep (in Maya) morning and evening,
those self-willed ones are bound by death, here and hereafter. ॥3॥
Those in whose hearts the Lord dwells day and night are perfect.
O Nanak, they meet the Lord, and their doubts are dispelled. ॥4॥11॥
One who loves the three qualities is born and dies.
The four Vedas speak only of the visible creation.
They describe the three states of mind,
but the fourth state, knowing the Lord, comes through the True Guru. ॥1॥
Through devotion to the Lord and service to the Guru, one crosses over;
ਬਾਹੁੜਿ; ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
then one is not born again, and does not die. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;
the Smritis, the Shastras and the pandits speak of them too.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਅਰਥੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
But without the Guru, their real meaning is not grasped.
The blessing of liberation is obtained through devotion to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
One in whose heart that Lord dwells
obtains devotion by facing the Guru.
Through devotion to the Lord comes the bliss of liberation;
through the Guru's teaching, supreme bliss is obtained. ॥3॥
One who has found Him — to him the Guru, having seen the Lord, has shown Him,
and taught him to remain free of hope amid hopes.
The Master of the meek is the Giver of all peace;
O Nanak, his mind is dyed in love for the Lord's feet. ॥4॥12॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਬਾਜੀ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Thinking itself immortal, the body seeks to live in comfort; but this world is only a play.
ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
You practise greed, avarice and great falsehood, and carry a heavy load.
ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ. ਮੈ ਰੁਲਦੀ ਦੇਖੀ; ਜਿਉ ਧਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
O body, I have seen bodies like you scattered like dust upon the earth. ॥1॥
Listen, listen to my advice, O my soul.
ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ. ਰਹਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only the good deeds you have done shall remain with you, O my soul; this chance shall not come again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
155: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ. ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ; ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
I instruct you, O my body: listen to my advice.
ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚਿੰਦਾ. ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ; ਝੂਠੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ॥
You slander others and dwell on it, and spread false gossip.
ਵੇਲਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ; ਕਰਹਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
You gaze at others' wives, O soul; you steal and do evil deeds.
ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ. ਤੂੰ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਹਿ; ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
When the swan (soul) departs, you shall be left behind, like an abandoned wife. ॥2॥
ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
O body, you remained in a dream; what deeds have you done?
ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ. ਮੈ ਜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਆ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Whatever I stole and brought, that pleased your mind.
ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ. ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ; ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
There is no honour in this world and no shelter in the next; you have wasted this priceless life. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਹੋਈ, ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ. ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have become utterly miserable, O Baba Nanak; no one asks about me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਾਜੀ ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ; ਕਪੜ ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Arabian and Turkish horses, gold and silver, and loads of clothes —
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
none of these go along with anyone, O Nanak; they fall away and are left behind, O fool.
ਕੂਜਾ ਮੇਵਾ. ਮੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
I have tasted sugar candy and dried fruits and everything; only Your Name is ambrosial nectar. ॥4॥
ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ. ਦਿਵਾਲ ਉਸਾਰੀ; ਭਸਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
Laying deep foundations, one builds walls; but they become heaps of dust.
ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ; ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
One hoards and hoards and gives nothing to anyone; the blind one thinks it is all his own.
ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੋਇਨ ਮਾੜੀ; ਸੰਪੈ. ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
Lanka of gold and palaces of gold — this wealth belongs to no one. ॥5॥
only His will shall prevail. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ; ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
My Banker is the great Lord and Master; we are His traders.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ; ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
Soul and body are all His capital; He Himself kills and revives. ॥6॥1॥13॥
ਅਵਰਿ ਪੰਚ. ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ; ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਉ. ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
They are five and I am alone; how can I protect my home, O mind?
ਮਾਰਹਿ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
They beat and rob me day after day; to whom can I complain? ॥1॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind;
ਆਗੈ; ਜਮ ਦਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ahead of you is the terrible, vast army of Death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਉਸਾਰਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ; ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
God built the temple of the body and gave it doors, and within it sits the soul-bride.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਅਵਰਿ ਲੁਟੇਨਿ. ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
Thinking herself immortal, the soul-bride plays her games, while the five thieves keep robbing her. ॥2॥
ਢਾਹਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ; ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
Death demolishes the temple, plunders the shrine, and the soul-bride is seized, alone.
ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਪੜਿਆ; ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ. ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
She is struck by Death's club, the chain is put around her neck, and the five have fled. ॥3॥
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲੋੜੈ. ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੁੜੇਨਿ, ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ ॥
The wife longs for gold and silver; friends and relatives long for food.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ; ਜਾਸੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, one sins for their sake, and goes bound to the city of Death. ॥4॥2॥14॥
ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿੰਥਾਤਾ ॥
Let the earrings be within your heart, O yogi; make your awareness of the body's transience your patched coat.
ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਡੰਡਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Bring the five senses under control as your disciples, O Raval, and make this mind your staff. ॥1॥
In this way you shall find the way of Yoga.
ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ; ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ. ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
There is only the One Word, and no other; yet you fix your mind on roots and fruits. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁੰਡਾਇਐ. ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੰਗਾਤਾ ॥
If the Guru could be found by shaving the head, then we have made the Guru our Ganges.
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਏਕੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਅੰਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
The blind one does not remember the One Lord, the Saviour of the three worlds. ॥2॥
ਕਰਿ ਪਟੰਬੁ. ਗਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿ; ਸੰਸਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
Putting on a show, you engage minds with talk, but your own doubt does not depart at all.
156: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ. ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ; ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
If you attach your consciousness to the feet of the One Lord, why would you run after greed and avarice? ॥3॥
Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, absorbing your mind in Him.
ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why do you speak such deceitful words, O yogi? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ. ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
The body is wild, the soul is foolish; life passes in saying "mine, mine".
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ. ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
Prays Nanak, when the naked body is burnt, then one regrets it afterwards. ॥4॥3॥15॥
ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ. ਮਨ ਏਕੈ; ਜੇ ਕਰਿ. ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
The One Lord in the mind is the medicine, mantra and remedy, if you make your consciousness firm in Him.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ. ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ; ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Take hold of the One who destroys the sinful deeds of birth after birth. ॥1॥
O mind, the One Master alone is (your protector), O brother.
ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ, ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your three qualities are absorbed in the world; the unseen Lord cannot be seen (through them). ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ; ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Maya seems as sweet as sugar to the body; we carry its load on our heads.
ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ. ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ. ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
The night is dark and nothing can be seen; the mouse (of death) gnaws at the rope (of life), O brother. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Whatever the self-willed do brings only pain; the Guru-facing obtain glory.
ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ. ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ; ਕਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Whatever He does, that alone comes to pass; past deeds cannot be erased. ॥3॥
ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ; ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Those imbued with His love are filled to overflowing and are never empty.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ. ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
If Nanak becomes the dust of their feet, then this fool may obtain something. ॥4॥4॥16॥
ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ. ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ; ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ. ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
Who is our mother, and who our father? From where have we come?
ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ; ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
We were formed from the fire of the womb and the bubble of the father's seed; for what purpose were we created? ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
O my Master, who can know Your virtues?
ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ; ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My faults cannot be counted. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ. ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ; ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
I have seen myself as so many trees and plants, and so many times born as animals;
ਕੇਤੇ. ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ; ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
so many times I came into the families of snakes, and so many times I flew as a bird. ॥2॥
ਹਟ ਪਟਣ. ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ; ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ. ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
One breaks into the shops of the city and well-built houses, steals, and comes home;
ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ. ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ. ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
he looks ahead and behind, but how can he hide from You? ॥3॥
ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ. ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ; ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
I have seen the river-banks and places of pilgrimage of the nine continents, and the shops, cities and bazaars.
ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ. ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Taking the scale, the trader began to weigh his deeds, and found You within his own heart. ॥4॥
ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ; ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
As the sea and the ocean are filled with water, so many are my faults.
ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ. ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ; ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Show mercy and bestow a little grace; You save even sinking stones. ॥5॥
ਜੀਅੜਾ. ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ; ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
My soul burns like fire, and the knife (of craving) cuts within.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
Prays Nanak, one who recognises His command finds peace day and night. ॥6॥5॥17॥
ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ; ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
You waste the night sleeping, and the day eating.
ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ; ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Human life is like a diamond, but it is being lost in exchange for a shell. ॥1॥
You have not known the Name of the Lord.
ਮੂੜੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O fool, you shall regret it afterwards. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ. ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ; ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who hoards boundless wealth cannot long for the Boundless Lord.
ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ. ਜੋ ਗਏ; ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
Those who go after boundless wealth lose the Boundless Lord. ॥2॥
ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
If one could obtain it merely by wishing, everyone would be rich.
157: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ; ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
It is decided according to one's deeds, even if everyone longs for it. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
O Nanak, the One who created the creation takes care of it.
ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
The Master's command cannot be known; who knows to whom He gives glory? ॥4॥1॥18॥
ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ; ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
If I were a deer, living in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots —
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
by the Guru's grace, I would meet my Husband Lord; I am a sacrifice to Him again and again. ॥1॥
I am a trader of the Lord;
ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ; ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your Name is my merchandise and my trade. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
If I were a cuckoo, living in the mango tree, I would contemplate the Word in poise.
ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
In poise and love I would meet my Husband Lord, whose sight and form are infinite. ॥2॥
ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
If I were a fish, living in the water, I would remember the Lord who cares for all beings.
ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ. ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
My Husband Lord dwells on this shore and the shore beyond; I would meet Him with my arms outstretched. ॥3॥
ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
If I were a snake, living in the earth, the Word would dwell within me and my fear would depart.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, they are forever happy soul-brides whose light merges in His Light. ॥4॥2॥19॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ; ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
In that house where the praises of the Creator are sung and He is contemplated —
ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ; ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
in that house, sing the songs of praise and remember the Creator. ॥1॥
ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
Sing the songs of praise of my Fearless Lord.
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to that song of praise which brings everlasting peace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ; ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Day after day He cares for His beings; the great Giver watches over all.
ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ. ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ. ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Your gifts cannot be valued; how can that Giver be measured? ॥2॥
ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
The year and the day of my wedding are pre-ordained; come together and pour the oil (of the wedding rite) on me.
ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ; ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
Give me your blessings, my friends, that I may be united with my Lord and Master. ॥3॥
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ; ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
This summons is sent to every house; these calls come every day.
ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
Remember the One who summons us, O Nanak; those days are drawing near. ॥4॥1॥20॥
Gauri Guareri · Chaupade · Guru Amar Das
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Meeting the Guru, one meets the Lord.
He Himself unites us in union with Himself.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
My God Himself knows all the ways.
By His command He unites, and one recognises Him through the Word. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
In the fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear depart.
ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ; ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Absorbed in His fear, one merges in the love of the True One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਹਰਿ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally comes to dwell in the mind.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
My God is great; His value cannot be estimated.
One who praises through the Word Him who has no end or limit —
my God, the Forgiver, forgives him. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Meeting the Guru, one is blessed with all wisdom and understanding;
158: the True Lord dwells in the purified mind.
When the True One dwells within, all one's deeds become true.
Sublime are the actions of one who reflects on the Word. ॥3॥
From the Guru, true service is obtained.
Rare is the one who, facing the Guru, recognises the Name.
The Giver, the Bestower, lives forever (over his head);
O Nanak, his love is attached to the Lord's Name. ॥4॥1॥21॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Rare is the one who obtains spiritual wisdom from the Guru.
One who understands through the Guru succeeds.
From the Guru come poise and reflection on the True One.
From the Guru, one finds the gate of liberation. ॥1॥
By perfect good fortune, the Guru comes and meets one,
and one merges in the True One, in true poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Meeting the Guru, the fire of craving is quenched.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Through the Guru, peace comes to dwell in the mind.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the Guru, one becomes pure, holy and clean.
Through the Guru, union comes through the Word. ॥2॥
Without the Guru, everyone wanders, deluded by doubt.
Without the Name, one suffers great pain.
One who becomes Guru-facing meditates on the Name.
Through the sight of the True One, true honour is obtained. ॥3॥
ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
To whom should we speak? He alone is the Giver.
When He grants His grace, union comes through the Word.
Meeting my Beloved, I sing the praises of the True One.
O Nanak, being true, I merge in the True One. ॥4॥2॥22॥
ਸੁ ਥਾਉ ਸਚੁ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
True is that place (the holy company) where the mind becomes pure.
One who dwells in the True One becomes true.
Through the True Word, one is known throughout the four ages.
The True One Himself is everything. ॥1॥
When His grace comes, He unites one with the holy company;
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
sitting there, one sings the praises of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Let this tongue burn, which is attached to duality,
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਨ ਚਾਖੈ; ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਇ ॥
which does not taste the Lord's essence and utters insipid words.
ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without understanding, body and mind become insipid.
Without the Name, the miserable one departs weeping. ॥2॥
ਰਸਨਾ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
One whose tongue has tasted the Lord's essence dwells in poise and love.
By the Guru's grace, one merges in the True One.
Imbued with the True One, one reflects on the Guru's Word,
and drinks the ambrosial nectar from the pure stream. ॥3॥
The vessel that is pure is absorbed in the Name.
Nothing stays in a vessel turned upside down.
Through the Guru's Word, the Name dwells in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੩॥
O Nanak, true is the vessel that thirsts for the Word. ॥4॥3॥23॥
ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ; ਮਨਿ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Some keep on singing, but their minds find no joy.
They sing in ego, and it is all in vain.
They truly sing who love the Name,
and reflect on the True Word of His praise. ॥1॥
One keeps singing (His praises) if it pleases the True Guru;
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his mind and body, imbued with the Name, become beautiful. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Some sing, and some perform devotional dances,
but without love they do not obtain the Name.
True devotion lies in love for the Guru's Word;
ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਸਦਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
such a devotee keeps the Husband Lord forever enshrined in the heart. ॥2॥
159: The fools perform devotional dances and show themselves off.
ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਟਪਹਿ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
They dance and leap about, but suffer great pain.
By dancing and leaping, devotion is not performed.
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
One who dies (to self) through the Word obtains devotion. ॥3॥
The Lord, the Lover of His devotees, Himself inspires devotional worship.
True devotion is to remove self-conceit from within.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
My True God knows all ways.
O Nanak, the one He forgives recognises the Name. ॥4॥4॥24॥
When one subdues the mind, its wandering ends.
Without dying (to self), how can one find the Lord?
Only one who knows the remedy can subdue the mind.
ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
That person understands that the mind is subdued through the Word. ॥1॥
The one whom He forgives, He blesses with glory:
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by the Guru's grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When one does the deeds of the Guru-facing,
ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
then one comes to understand this mind.
The mind is drunk with ego, like an elephant drunk with wine.
The Guru strikes it with the goad and revives it. ॥2॥
The mind is unruly; only a rare one subdues it.
When one consumes its stubbornness, it becomes pure.
The Guru-facing have reformed this mind,
and cast off ego and vice from within. ॥3॥
Those whom He has saved from the beginning, uniting them with the Guru,
are never separated; they remain absorbed in the Word.
He Himself knows His own power.
O Nanak, the Guru-facing recognise the Name. ॥4॥5॥25॥
The whole world has gone mad in ego.
In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.
ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ; ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
It thinks many anxious thoughts, but does not recognise its own self.
Night and day pass in worldly affairs. ॥1॥
Contemplate the Lord in your heart, O my brother.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Facing the Guru, let your tongue savour the essence of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who, facing the Guru, recognises the Lord in the heart,
serving the Life of the World, is known throughout the four ages.
Subduing ego, he recognises Him through the Guru's Word,
when God, the Architect of destiny, grants His grace. ॥2॥
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
True are those whom He unites with the Guru's Word,
whose wandering mind He restrains and holds steady.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
They obtain the Name, the nine treasures, from the Guru.
ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
By the Lord's grace, the Lord comes to dwell in their minds. ॥3॥
ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਤਿਆ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, the body finds peace and tranquillity.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
When He dwells within, the pain of death does not touch one.
He Himself is the Master, and He Himself the counsellor.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, serve forever the Lord, the deep treasure of virtues. ॥4॥6॥26॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Why forget Him, to whom soul and breath belong?
ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Why forget Him, who is pervading in all?
Serving Him, one is honoured and accepted in His court. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.
ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ; ਤਦਿ ਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If I forget You, at that very moment I die. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ; ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
They forget You, whom You Yourself have led astray.
160: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ; ਜਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
They forget You, who are attached to duality.
The ignorant self-willed are cast into the cycle of births. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ; ਸੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Those with whom the One Lord is pleased are put to the service of the True Guru.
ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ; ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Those with whom the One Lord is pleased — in their minds He enshrines Himself.
Through the Guru's teaching, they merge in the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ; ਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Those who have good fortune in their account reflect on spiritual wisdom.
ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ; ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Those who have good fortune in their account subdue their ego.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੭॥
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Name. ॥4॥7॥27॥
You are indescribable; how can You be described?
Those who have the Guru's Word, which subdues the mind, find You dwelling in their mind.
ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Your virtues are countless; their value cannot be estimated. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
The Word of praise belongs to Him, and is absorbed in Him.
ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your story is indescribable; this is what the Guru's Word has told. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Where the True Guru is, there the holy company is formed.
ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਸਹਜੇ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
Where the True Guru is, one sings the Lord's praises in poise.
ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਤਹਾ ਹਉਮੈ. ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Where the True Guru is, ego is burnt away by the Word. ॥2॥
Through service, the Guru-facing one finds a place in His mansion.
The Guru-facing one enshrines the Lord's Name within.
Through devotion, the Guru-facing one merges in the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
The Giver Himself gives the gift,
and one comes to love the Perfect True Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੮॥
O Nanak, those imbued with the Name are applauded everywhere. ॥4॥8॥28॥
ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ; ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
From the One come all forms and colours.
Air, water and fire — all are blended together.
ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਵੇਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
The Lord God watches over all the different forms and colours. ॥1॥
It is a wonder: the One Lord alone is (in all).
Rare is the one who, facing the Guru, reflects on this. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Abiding in poise, God pervades all places.
ਕਹਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Somewhere hidden, somewhere manifest — God has fashioned this whole creation.
He Himself awakens those who are asleep. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
No one has found His value,
ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨੁ; ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
though everyone speaks and describes Him again and again.
ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
One who merges in the Guru's Word understands the Lord. ॥3॥
Listening and listening (to our prayers), He watches over us, and unites us with the Word.
ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Great glory is obtained through service to the Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੯॥
O Nanak, those imbued with the Name merge in the Lord's Name. ॥4॥9॥29॥
The self-willed one is asleep in attachment to and love of Maya.
The Guru-facing one is awake, reflecting on the virtues and on spiritual wisdom.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ; ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
Those people are awake who love the Name. ॥1॥
One who is awake in poise does not fall asleep (in Maya);
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
rare is the one who understands this through the Perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The wicked, stubborn one never understands.
ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰੇ; ਤੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
He talks (of wisdom), yet stays entangled with Maya.
The blind and ignorant one never succeeds. ॥2॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
In this age, liberation comes through the Lord's Name.
ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Rare is the one who reflects on this through the Guru's Word.
He himself crosses over and saves all his generations. ॥3॥
